purpose: Source-only, default-disabled, read-only aggregate preflight for Phase D CHECKs owned by immutable migration 028 (date_window + price_unit). Counts only — never row values, identifiers, guest data, or arbitrary SQL.

constraints.name: tenant_services_date_window
constraints.predicate: (end_date IS NULL OR start_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date)
constraints.violationPredicate: NOT (end_date IS NULL OR start_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date)

aggregateContract.authorizedAggregateSql:
SELECT
  count(*)::bigint AS total_rows,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (end_date IS NULL OR start_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date))::bigint AS date_window_violations,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (price_unit IN ('per_day', 'per_week', 'per_stay', 'one_off')))::bigint AS price_unit_violations
FROM public.tenant_services
